squash-domesticated-guila-naquitz.research_focus: Guilá Naquitz cave in the Oaxaca valley, early Archaic foragers and wild Cucurbita pepo
squash-domesticated-guila-naquitz.scene: At the mouth of a dry rock shelter, a forager kneels pressing squash seeds into a small cleared patch, a gourd and a stone grinding slab beside them

cacao-use-santa-ana-la-florida.research_focus: the Mayo-Chinchipe culture at Santa Ana-La Florida in the Ecuadorian upper Amazon, its stone and spouted ceramic vessels, and wild cacao pods
cacao-use-santa-ana-la-florida.scene: Under a forest canopy, hands split open a ridged cacao pod above a carved stone bowl, a spouted clay vessel waiting beside it

zapotecs-found-monte-alban.research_focus: early Monte Albán in the Oaxaca valley, the levelled mountaintop, its first platforms and carved danzante slabs
zapotecs-found-monte-alban.scene: Workers haul baskets of earth across a flattened mountaintop as the first stone platform rises, the valley falling away far below

el-mirador-maya-city-rises.research_focus: Late Preclassic El Mirador in the Petén basin of Guatemala, the La Danta complex and its stuccoed triadic pyramids
el-mirador-maya-city-rises.scene: A colossal stepped pyramid crowned by three small temples rises out of dense lowland jungle, tiny builders on its terraces for scale

teotihuacan-city-founded.research_focus: early Teotihuacan in the Valley of Mexico, its grid plan and the laying out of the Avenue of the Dead
teotihuacan-city-founded.scene: Surveyors stretch long cords across an open valley floor to mark a broad straight avenue, the first low stone platforms rising beside it under distant mountains

chiapa-de-corzo-long-count-stela.research_focus: Chiapa de Corzo in Chiapas, Epi-Olmec carved stone stelae and Late Preclassic stone-working
chiapa-de-corzo-long-count-stela.scene: A sculptor kneels before an upright stone slab, chisel and hammerstone in hand, its face covered in worn, indistinct carved relief; no legible signs or numbers

lord-of-sipan-burial.research_focus: the Moche royal tomb at Huaca Rajada, Sipán, the Lord of Sipán's gold and turquoise regalia, ear spools and crescent headdress
lord-of-sipan-burial.scene: Inside an adobe burial chamber, attendants lower a ruler laid out in gold ear spools, a crescent headdress and beaded pectorals into a plank coffin

teotihuacan-conquers-tikal.research_focus: the 378 entrada of Siyaj K'ak' at Tikal, Teotihuacan-style warrior dress with atlatls and goggled headdresses, and Tikal's Classic plaza
teotihuacan-conquers-tikal.scene: A column of warriors in feathered helmets, carrying spear-throwers and rectangular shields, marches into a Maya plaza ringed by steep temples as townspeople watch

copan-dynasty-founded.research_focus: K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' and Altar Q at Copán, Honduras, and the Copán valley's early acropolis
copan-dynasty-founded.scene: A Maya lord in a feathered headdress, shield on his arm, stands at the head of a procession entering a lush river valley ringed by hills

teotihuacan-burned-collapse.research_focus: the burning of Teotihuacan's ceremonial core along the Avenue of the Dead around 550
teotihuacan-burned-collapse.scene: Flames and smoke pour from the temples lining a broad stone avenue at night, the great pyramid a silhouette behind, small figures fleeing; no injured people

calakmul-defeats-tikal.research_focus: Classic Maya warfare in 562, Calakmul's snake-head emblem as a war banner, and Tikal's temples
calakmul-defeats-tikal.scene: Maya warriors carrying a banner topped by a carved snake head surge up the steps of an enemy temple, its defenders falling back; no bloodshed

pakal-tomb-sealed-palenque.research_focus: the Temple of the Inscriptions at Palenque, its interior stairway and Pakal's carved stone sarcophagus lid
pakal-tomb-sealed-palenque.scene: Deep in a vaulted stone crypt, torch-lit workers lower a massive carved stone lid onto a sarcophagus, a jade mask resting on the figure within

tikal-temple-i-built.research_focus: Temple I at Tikal, its steep nine-level profile, roof comb and Great Plaza, around 732
tikal-temple-i-built.scene: Builders on wooden scaffolding finish the tall roof comb of a steep, narrow pyramid towering over a broad stone plaza and the jungle canopy

chan-chan-rises.research_focus: Chan Chan, the Chimú adobe capital near Trujillo, its walled ciudadelas and friezes of fish, birds and waves
chan-chan-rises.scene: Workers press mud into wooden moulds and stack adobe bricks along a high wall decorated with rows of relief fish and seabirds, the ocean beyond

chichen-itza-rises.research_focus: Chichen Itza in the Terminal Classic and early Postclassic, El Castillo, the Sacred Cenote and feathered-serpent imagery
chichen-itza-rises.scene: Pilgrims climb toward a broad stepped pyramid with serpent heads at the foot of its stairway, set on a flat limestone plain

cusco-founded-legend.research_focus: the Inca origin legend of Manco Cápac and Mama Ocllo, the golden staff sinking into the earth, and the Cusco valley
cusco-founded-legend.scene: A leader in a woven tunic plunges a gold staff into the ground of a high Andean valley as a small band of followers looks on; legend, not a city yet

pachacuti-becomes-inca.research_focus: Pachacuti's defence of Cusco against the Chanka and his accession, Inca royal dress, the mascapaicha fringe and litter
pachacuti-becomes-inca.scene: A victorious Inca ruler wearing a woven fringe across his brow is borne on a litter through cheering warriors, the Andes rising behind

inca-conquer-chimu.research_focus: the Inca conquest of the Chimú around 1470, Inca soldiers' slings and star-headed maces, and the adobe walls of Chan Chan
inca-conquer-chimu.scene: Inca soldiers with slings and star-headed maces file through a gate in high adobe walls, captured metalsmiths carrying their tools behind them

tenochtitlan-conquers-tlatelolco.research_focus: the 1473 war between Tenochtitlan and Tlatelolco, Mexica eagle and jaguar warriors, and Tlatelolco's market and temple
tenochtitlan-conquers-tlatelolco.scene: Eagle and jaguar warriors swarm up the steps of a temple above an island marketplace, traders scattering among baskets and canoes; no bloodshed

templo-mayor-dedicated.research_focus: the 1487 rededication of the Templo Mayor of Tenochtitlan, its twin shrines to Huitzilopochtli and Tlaloc, priests and processions
templo-mayor-dedicated.scene: Long processions of priests and warriors climb a great pyramid crowned by two shrines, incense smoke rising over a packed plaza; nothing graphic

moctezuma-ii-crowned.research_focus: Mexica royal investiture, the turquoise xiuhuitzolli diadem and cloak, and the palaces of Tenochtitlan in 1502
moctezuma-ii-crowned.scene: A ruler stands with arms raised as a priest places a pointed turquoise diadem on his head, nobles bowing low across a palace courtyard
